name: incident-task-create
description: Validate Create Incident Task save, cancel, or inactive-Incident behavior in the classic UI.

incident_sys_id.description: Optional active Incident sys_id. The recipe selects the most recently updated active Incident when omitted.

steps: Open the selected Incident or choose a recent Incident matching the scenario
Verify the action is hidden for an inactive Incident, or open the task proposal
Verify the unsaved task is linked to the Incident and prepopulated
Save and reopen the task, or cancel and verify no task was persisted
